title.en: winter wonderland opens in hyde park.
title.de: winter wonderland öffnet im hyde park.

line.en: the christmas fair runs from the 19th to 3 january, closed on christmas day. check the opening hours on the site first; a weekday evening is quieter.
line.de: der weihnachtsjahrmarkt läuft vom 19. november bis 3. januar, an weihnachten geschlossen. die öffnungszeiten vorher auf der seite prüfen; ein wochentagabend ist ruhiger.
line.tr: noel lunaparkı 19 kasımdan 3 ocak'a kadar açık, 25 aralık'ta kapalı. açılış saatlerini önce siteden kontrol et; hafta içi akşamı daha sakin.

sparks.why: Hyde Park Winter Wonderland runs 19 Nov 2026 to 3 Jan 2027 per the official ticket guide (hydeparkwinterwonderland.com); one listing says 20 Nov and the opening hours were not confirmed. Day 8 of the window, added because the week is thin.
